definitions.certified_point: registered_discrete_verdict == CERTIFIED; not scientific admission or rigorous supremum.
definitions.initial_ratio: levels[1].eps / levels[0].eps; may exceed1.1 then be resolved by the recorded level2.
definitions.missing: No EPS_NUMERIC file at the initial directory snapshot; not inferred to be failed or unstarted.
definitions.near: Descriptive bins only: (1.05,1.10] below and (1.10,1.15] above; tight bins also reported. No acceptance-rule change.
definitions.shell_instance: One point-specific saved shell; identical k intervals at different points count separately.
definitions.terminal_ratio: eps_refined / eps_base; saved final comparison. For refinements=0 these are levels1/0; for refinements=1 or2 levels2/1.
definitions.time: Snapshot date_u from actual /bin/date -u; saved record UTC separately retained per point.
